body.message:
Please note that If you paid your security deposit with a payment link before or on arrival, your deposit will be refunded within seven working days.

If you paid your security deposit with a credit/debit card or via bank transfer on arrival with your guest relation executive, please expect the deposit to be refunded within a maximum of 14 working days.

If you paid your security deposit in cash, it would be refunded in cash within 7 working days.

If you have stayed for more than 15 days, then your booking would be considered as a long-term booking. All long-term bookings will be refunded within 14 working days as well.
